{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection3","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    private const string NestedCompositeResolverSource = \"\"\"\n        using MessagePack;\n        using MessagePack.Resolvers;\n\n        namespace TempProject\n        {\n            public partial class OuterContainer\n            {\n                [CompositeResolver(typeof(StandardResolver))]\n                public partial class NestedCompositeResolver\n                {\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        \"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_EmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverage_WithBalancedDirectives()\n    {\n        (Compilation outputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAsync(NestedCompositeResolverSource);\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> errors = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToImmutableArray();\n        Assert.Empty(errors);\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult generatedResolverSource = Assert.Single(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"partial class NestedCompositeResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        string generatedText = generatedResolverSource.SourceText.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"#endif\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? outerSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.OuterContainer\");\n        Assert.NotNull(outerSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            outerSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.OuterContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            resolverSymbol.AllInterfaces,\n            i => i.ToDisplayString() == \"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n        Assert.Contains(\n            resolverSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\", 1).SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            formatterCacheSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_ExcludesAttribute_WhenNetStandard20Defined()\n    {\n        (Compilation outputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAsync(NestedCompositeResolverSource, \"NETSTANDARD2_0\");\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.OuterContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            resolverSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\", 1).SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            formatterCacheSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedCompositeResolver_ExcludesAttribute_WhenNetFrameworkDefined()\n    {\n        (Compilation outputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics) =\n            await RunGeneratorAsync(NestedCompositeResolverSource, \"NETFRAMEWORK\");\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverSymbol = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.OuterContainer+NestedCompositeResolver\");\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            resolverSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheSymbol = resolverSymbol.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\", 1).SingleOrDefault();\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheSymbol);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            formatterCacheSymbol.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(Compilation OutputCompilation, GeneratorDriverRunResult RunResult, ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> GeneratorDiagnostics)> RunGeneratorAsync(\n        string source,\n        params string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        return (outputCompilation, driver.GetRunResult(), generatorDiagnostics);\n    }\n}\n"}
